name: dn-multi-ava-rdn-excluded-invalid
description: excludedSubtrees directoryName is C=US,O=Example+OU=Engineering (a multi-AVA RDN). The leaf's subject begins with exactly that multi-AVA RDN sequence and adds a CN below it. The leaf is inside the excluded subtree and must be rejected.
notes: Mirrors dn-multi-ava-rdn-match-valid but flipped from permitted to excluded so the multi-AVA structural match is exercised on the rejection path.
